result_summary.title: Connection failures: TLS errors and DNS lookups failing in ANZ
result_summary.description: We are seeing intermittent connection failures in the ANZ production environment. Our systems are throwing TLS handshake errors and occasional DNS lookup failures when trying to communicate with external services. It is difficult to tell if the issue lies within the Rate Limiter configuration or if it is related to our Object Storage Service endpoints, as both are affected during these windows. We have only 2 users impacted currently, but the error type is confusing.
